Maker claims or named finishing options only; no demonstrated application validation, suitability or screening pass. Other products of the material remain individually bounded. The source attributes UL94 V0 to the base resin; no printed-part certificate is established.

Reviewed 2026-09-30: Nanovia Insublend (G081-06), now filed under PPE-PS from its own SDS, has maker-intended electrical/industrial uses (Q04262/Q04263/Q05378) and explicit use restrictions (Q05379/Q05380). These are claims, not printed-part application validation or suitability. The SDS contradicts itself on food contact; medical, food and mouth-contact use remain unqualified. This scoped judgment complements the retained THERMAX PPE/PS judgment C01506; no formulation, resin approval or measured value transfers between products.

Reviewed 2026-09-30: Insublend SDS September 2023 (R-NANOVIA-INSUBLEND-SDS-202309-afadf4eb9e7c) §1.2 prohibits food/drinking-fluid contact and mouth-contact toys, while §7.2 says the product is approved for food contact. Both English and French repeat this internal disagreement (Q05379/Q05380). Retain both statements; vendor clarification and applicable certificate/test scope are needed. No food-contact suitability or approval is established.
